# Proficiency Level

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:ProficiencyLevel`](gmeow-ProficiencyLevel.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ProficiencyLevel>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/expertise`](../../slices/expertise.md)

An attained proficiency level on a scale (CEFR A1–C2; Dreyfus novice→expert; NIH beginner→expert; assessed; native; heritage). A value carried by [`gmeow:proficiencyLevel`](../properties/gmeow-proficiencyLevel.md) and [`gmeow:skillProficiencyLevel`](../properties/gmeow-skillProficiencyLevel.md); [`gmeow:levelScale`](../properties/gmeow-levelScale.md) ties it to its scale. ILR (0–5) and ACTFL levels are added as further individuals.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:ProficiencyLevel`](gmeow-ProficiencyLevel.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
